explanation: Unseasonably warm September; cold-weather outerwear demand did not start. The August seasonal outlook already pointed to a warm autumn and the model has no weather input.
Early-autumn outerwear promotion was shortened after the forecast was frozen, but its uplift stayed in the baseline.
Price increase on core parkas not reflected in price elasticity.
Northern and Scottish store clusters were forecast on last year's early cold snap.
Autumn launch styles ramped slower than the comparable launches used in the forecast.
